title: A new line can be created No Charge from New Line
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with its own labor rate of $120.00 an hour.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved, billable.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click New Line.
  3. Type a line title.
  4. Tick the "No Charge" checkbox.
  5. Pick "Goodwill" in Category.
  6. Click Save.
  7. Hover over the "No Charge" chip on the new line.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The New Line window opens with the No Charge checkbox at the bottom.

Step 3:

  • The title shows.

Step 4:

  • The Category select appears.

Step 5:

  • Goodwill is picked.

Step 6:

  • The new line shows the chip "No Charge" and $0.00.
  • The chip shows only the words "No Charge", with no category name in it.

Step 7:

  • A tooltip reads "Category: Goodwill".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.4 (13 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 14 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S12-R1: “On a billable work order, while the setting is on and the work order is not invoiced, the three-dots menu of every line offers "Mark as No Charge" between Edit line and Delete line. Edit Line and New Line show at the bottom, under a divider, the checkbox "No Charge" with the helper "This line shows $0.00 on the invoice. Hours and parts stay; the parts cost posts to the category's expense account." and, when ticked, the selects Category *, Original work order and Original line of S2-R2, so a line can be created No Charge. Both doors write the same fields. Lines the Line Builder creates (it has no dialog) are marked afterwards from the line menu.”
  • S12-R3: “A no-charge line shows the chip "No Charge" next to its title on the lines table, in Tech View and on mobile, with the tooltip "Category: [category]" on hover, as the work order badge has (S2-R16); the category itself is not printed in the chip; Rate, Total and every part on it show $0.00; Margin shows nothing. Hours, technician, status, approval, parts ordering, picking, receiving, clock-ins, notes, inspections and the story work as on any line. The original work order and line are not shown on the line; they are in the notes, the Audit Log, the report and the hub record.”
